reason: [SONNET-4.6] sq-yz27r / issue #3251 adds the opt-in `Store::loadJsonLdWithContexts` binding to crates/sparq-wasm. NO always-compiled CODE is added or changed: the whole implementation lives in the new `crates/sparq-wasm/src/jsonld_context.rs`, which is reachable only through `#[cfg(feature = "jsonld-contexts")] mod jsonld_context;`, and that feature is OFF by default and is enabled by nothing in the default resolution — so the feature-OFF sparq-wasm bundle compiles zero bytes of it. The new `oxjsonld` dependency in crates/sparq-wasm/Cargo.toml is OPTIONAL and enabled only by `jsonld-contexts` (`dep:oxjsonld`), so it never enters the default wasm graph; the Cargo.lock delta is the single edge added to sparq-wasm's dependency list, with no version or feature change to any resolved crate. The remaining edits — crates/sparq-wasm/tests/web.rs, two build+clippy steps and one wasm-pack step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, and skills/javascript-wasm/SKILL.md — are test, CI and documentation surfaces that are not linked into the bundle at all. The bundle bytes are therefore expected to move for a purely POSITIONAL reason — the mechanism identified by inspection, not observed locally (see the reproduction caveat below), and the same one declared in #4443, #4369 and #4012: the 11 lines of `#[cfg]` module registration plus its rationale comment are inserted at crates/sparq-wasm/src/lib.rs:113, ABOVE the always-compiled `#[wasm_bindgen] impl QueryCursor::next` body, so every subsequent line in that file shifts by exactly 11 — including the slice-range index `&self.result.rows[self.pos..end]`, which moves from line 183 at base to line 194 at head and is the one always-compiled panic-capable site below the insertion point in this file. Its bounds-check `core::panic::Location` line number is emitted as a `u32` constant (the workspace release profile sets `panic = "abort"` but not `panic_immediate_abort`, so the Location constants are retained), making this an expected same-LENGTH content change, which the byte-for-byte gate detects regardless of size. This is NOT an accidental default-path or `vectorized` leak — the invariant this gate exists to protect: no cargo feature is enabled by default, no dependency enters the default wasm graph, no `unsafe` is introduced, no existing gate is widened or removed, no `vectorized`/SIMD code path becomes reachable, and no default-path behaviour changes. NO byte delta is claimed here: the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` std component cannot be installed in the authoring checkout (read-only rustup directory, so the pinned 1.97.1 toolchain cannot be materialised either), so the base-vs-head comparison was NOT reproduced locally — CI leg 2 performs the actual byte comparison. The accepted SIZE of the change remains governed SEPARATELY, unchanged, by the `metrics.wasm_bundle_bytes` +/-2% floor ratchet in bench/perf-baseline.json / bench.yml, which a line-number shift is not expected to approach.
